content:
Context: 3. Stepping up

Instances which do not constitute anomaly for stepping up of pay. The following instances do not constitute an anomaly of junior drawing more pay than the senior and stepping up of pay will not be admissible in such cases:-  
- (i) Extraordinary Leave resulting in postponement of the date of next increment with consequent drawal of less pay than the junior in the lower grade itself; pay parity cannot be claimed even if promoted earlier to the higher grade.
